notes:
• Ronin accounts are here: sign in (Settings → Account) to sync your playlists, favourites, watching history and sports follows across your devices
• Panel passwords never leave your phone — if a synced playlist needs one, the app asks for just the password after you sign in
• Forgot your password? Reset it right from the sign-in screen
• Signing in keeps the profile already on your phone — no duplicate profiles
• Home: 3 new rails (IMDb Popular Movies, IMDb Popular Shows, Trakt Trending Shows) — 12 rails in a fresh order each open, Continue Watching stays on top
• Faster cold opens: Home rails are saved on your phone, so the full Home shows right away and refreshes in the background
• The loading screen now waits until Home is fully loaded
• Fixed a crash that could stop the app opening after app data was cleared
• New Logs page under Settings → About
